task.description:
WF-04 Step 2 — Unit Tests. Run ALL unit tests (no module filter).

1. Run `zig build test` to run all Zig unit tests.
2. Run `cd web && npm run test` to run all frontend unit tests (if any).

Classify failures:
- BLOCKER: test covers a MUST requirement
- MAJOR: test covers a SHOULD requirement
- MINOR: other

If BLOCKER or MAJOR failures: status = FAIL with detailed issue list.
If only MINOR or all PASS: status = PASS.

Write results to tests/reports/WF04-full-20260523-step02-unit-tests.md
acceptance_criteria: zig build test exits 0 (or only MINOR failures)
